name: waplugin
description: Search authorized WhatsApp conversations, view media, and send, forward, edit text messages, or add reactions with independent per-phone permissions.

interface.longDescription: waplugin connects your authorized WhatsApp accounts to your AI assistant so you can catch up on conversations and communicate with contacts and groups. Search retained messages, summarize chats, find contacts and groups, view retained media and shared contacts, and check account connection status. When you ask, send text or media, forward messages, media or contacts, edit your own recently sent text, or add reactions. Read access, sending, forwarding, editing, and reactions each require an independent permission for the selected phone. Results reflect retained history and may not include every message. Editing is limited to retained text sent by that phone within 15 minutes of the original send.
capabilities: Text and media messages with permission
Forwarded text, media, and contacts with permission
Text message edits with separate permission
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's messages in a WhatsApp chat.
Find a contact or group in my WhatsApp accounts.
Check the connection status of my WhatsApp accounts.
